items.fullSentence: Je voudrais un café, s'il vous plaît.
items.sentenceTrans: I would like a coffee, please.

whyWrong.voudrez: voudrez is the future vous form — the polite request with je is voudrais.
whyWrong.voulez: voulez is the present vous form — a polite 'I would like' is je voudrais.
whyWrong.veut: veut is the il/elle form — with je, politely, it's voudrais.

whyWrong.envie: avoir envie de means 'to feel like/want' — 'need' is avoir besoin.
whyWrong.faim: faim means 'hunger' — 'need a hotel' is avoir besoin.

whyWrong.aimerait: aimerait is the il/elle conditional — with je it's aimerais.
whyWrong.aimeriez: aimeriez is the vous conditional — with je it's aimerais.
whyWrong.aimes: aimes is the tu present — a polite 'I'd like' with je is aimerais.

items.sentenceTrans: I want to go on holiday.

whyWrong.pars: pars is a present-tense form (je/tu) — after veux use the infinitive: partir.
whyWrong.part: part is the il/elle present — after veux use the infinitive: partir.
whyWrong.parti: parti is the past participle — after veux use the infinitive: partir.
